answer: Each identity keeps a sequential-work chain: every epoch it extends a verifiable delay computation seeded by its own key, timber laid end to end, each round impossible to rush or run in parallel with itself. No ivory shortcut exists; the chain grows only at real-time speed, and the public delta between chain tips lets anyone audit for stalls. One operator can sustain only as many live chains as he has cores, so a thousand masks demand a thousand machines running nonstop, while an honest agent's chain idles on spare cycles. Keys clone for free; elapsed sequential time does not.
